name: Jinja
title: Dokkai Dojo
lead: JLPT reading drills N5-N1 set at a fictional neighborhood Shinto shrine (Suzuka Jinja): a New Year's reception-hours change notice, a first day working part-time as a shrine maiden, an omikuji-and-charm guide, an online prayer-reservation notice, an old-charm-exchange and stamp-book guide for first-timers, a lesson in rephrasing the difference between two kinds of charms simply, teaching a junior the morning check order before opening, the shrine's history of switching from a paper guest register to a tablet, a monthly charm-subscription guide, a column on the discussion behind allowing photography during a ritual, a hybrid paper-card-plus-app visit-record guide, a reflection on balancing speed and warmth, and a fifty-year anniversary report. Original texts, answers with the reason for every choice.
